## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the [天親菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A9%E8%A6%AA%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9) Vasubandhu commentary on the *Yí jiào jīng* 遺教經 ([KR6g0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0043), T0389), translated by [真諦](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E8%AB%A6) Paramārtha during his Chén-period activity. The work is the principal Indian śāstra-commentary on the Buddha's *bequeathed teaching*.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Paramārtha's Chén period (557–569 CE).
